battery.title: Battery
battery.description: Map the entities representing your hybrid inverter's battery.

data.reserve_soc_sensor: Reserve SoC floor sensor (optional; reads the live minimum-SoC entity, e.g. GivEnergy battery_soc_reserve)

tariff.title: Tariff
tariff.description: Off-peak rate signals from your tariff provider integration.

data.off_peak_sensor: Off-peak rate sensor (whole house; active during overnight off-peak window and intra-day dispatch slots)
data.dispatching_sensor: Smart dispatch active (optional; e.g. Octopus Intelligent)

forecast_source.title: Solar forecast — source
forecast_source.description: Pick the kind of solar forecast available in Home Assistant.

data.forecast_solcast_sensor: Solcast forecast sensor (use the 'Forecast Tomorrow' sensor for overnight planning)
data.solar_generation_sensor: Actual generation sensor (optional; enables stats-based fallback)

loads.title: Loads & learning
loads.description: Optional inputs for baseline-load and daily-target learning.

data.home_load_sensor: Home load power sensor (optional; learns the calculated baseline)
data.managed_load_sensors: Managed loads to exclude from baseline (EV, hot-water diverter, …)
data.daily_energy_sensor: House energy sensor (optional; learns the daily kWh target from recorder history)
data.daily_kwh_target: Daily kWh target (fallback constant when not learned)

ev.title: EV charger (optional)
ev.description: If present, enables the EV-dispatch discharge regime.

behaviour.title: Behaviour
behaviour.description: Write mode, notification target and planning schedule.

data.min_target_soc_percent: Minimum overnight SoC target (%) — safety floor above the BMS reserve
data.device_name: Site name (appended to 'Energy Conductor', e.g. 'Blithe' → 'Energy Conductor Blithe')
